_comment: CURATED COMMUNITY LIST (not official open data): the project's own live-video wall. 17 Hong Kong live cameras and 16 international news channels, the ones the project owner chose. Every tile is labelled 第三方 / third-party. Live state is resolved at runtime by probeLive (hqdefault_live.jpg) - an off-air tile says 現時無直播 instead of playing a black rectangle. If a channel dies, remove its row.
_verification: Audit every id with `node web/scripts/probe-livestreams.mjs` (defaults to this file). Re-resolve a channel handle to its CURRENT live id with `node web/scripts/resolve-live-news.mjs <@handle>` - that script must run from a residential IP; YouTube answers a datacenter range with a shell page that has no video id in it.
_selection_rule: News entries must stream 24/7 AND brand themselves as such. The resolver surfaces plenty of ids that are today's EVENT feed - @financialtimes returned a weekend festival, @tbsnewsdig and @ANNnewsCH put the date in the live title and rotate daily, @ETtoday returned a single rally. Hardcoding any of those recreates the GxMB-EH_lJs failure: the id dies with the event and the tile 404s in silence. If a title contains a date or an event name it does NOT belong here.
_hk_gap: There is exactly one Hong Kong NEWS source category missing, deliberately: RTHK only does event feeds, and TVB / i-CABLE / now / HOY keep their news channels in their own apps, so no free 24/7 YouTube HK news stream exists. Twelve handles were tested and every one returned 404 or no live. HK coverage stays on the camera side, which is a genuine strength rather than a consolation: 1,013 TD + 34 HKO cameras is a density no global project has.
_regions: region is the tab this stream appears under. The tab set, their order and their labels are ALL derived from this file - adding a region is a data change, not a code change. Order is first-seen, so 香港 leads because the HK entries are written first.
